gamescope_arg.upscaler: Upscaling mode for the game. AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0 is used when set to fsr, NVIDIA Image Scaling 1.0.3 is used when set to nis
gamescope_arg.wh: Resolution of game window. If -h is specified but -w is not 16:9 aspect ratio is assumed. Defaults to the values specified in -W and -H
